import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sleep_health.csv')

# Create a figure with subplots
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(16, 12))
fig.suptitle('Sleep Health Analysis: Key Factors and Relationships', fontsize=18, fontweight='bold', y=0.995)

# 1. Sleep Duration by Occupation (Top 10)
ax1 = axes[0, 0]
occupation_sleep = df.groupby('Occupation')['Sleep Duration'].mean().sort_values(ascending=False).head(10)
colors1 = sns.color_palette('viridis', len(occupation_sleep))
occupation_sleep.plot(kind='barh', ax=ax1, color=colors1)
ax1.set_xlabel('Average Sleep Duration (hours)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_ylabel('Occupation', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')

df_clean = df.copy()

disorders = df_clean['Sleep Disorder'].unique()
colors2 = sns.color_palette('Set2', len(disorders))

for i, disorder in enumerate(disorders):
    subset = df_clean[df_clean['Sleep Disorder'] == disorder]
    ax2.scatter(subset['Physical Activity Level'], subset['Quality of Sleep'],

ax2.set_xlabel('Physical Activity Level', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_ylabel('Quality of Sleep', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_title('Sleep Quality vs Physical Activity by Sleep Disorder', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', pad=10)
ax2.legend(title='Sleep Disorder', title_fontsize=10, fontsize=9, loc='best')
ax2.grid(alpha=0.3)

bmi_order = ['Normal', 'Overweight', 'Obese']

ax3.set_xlabel('BMI Category', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_ylabel('Sleep Duration (hours)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_title('Sleep Duration Distribution by BMI Category', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', pad=10)
ax3.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# 4. Correlation Heatmap of Key Health Metrics
ax4 = axes[1, 1]
metrics = ['Sleep Duration', 'Quality of Sleep', 'Physical Activity Level', 
           'Stress Level', 'Heart Rate', 'Daily Steps']
